_timing: Block 1 (new arenas, today's new sheets, focus god only; live arena and «вчера» sheets unchanged): (1) STG.playAnim: sheet duration D = clamp(max(hitAt/rel, floor), .3, max) with floor 1.25 s strike / 1.5 s super+ult and max 1.7 / 2.0. (2) When the release frame D*rel comes later than the script expects (hitAt; .5 for OLD_SIG supers/ults; REL_NEW; leapAt), fx2 calls BR.hold(lag): app.js stops stepping the sim and fx2 of THAT arena for lag seconds while the sprites keep playing (scriptDt in tick/stepManual). So the whole script of the action - anticipation, leap, launch, projectiles, pending hits, damage numbers - runs lag later; order and all sim values are unchanged; nothing else acts on the stand during that time. Lag is 0.06-0.56 s (median 0.23 s; Susanoo BT ult 0.85 s). (3) Strikes whose release frame is too early even at the slowest playback (>0.08 s before the expected moment: Brynhild, Indra, Zeus TI, Heimdall, Ra BT atk): the sheet starts later by that gap (idle pose until then), nothing else moves. (4) LEAP_NEW leap (Brynhild) is fast: starts 0.31 s before the strike instead of at 0.03 s. (5) Auto-repeat wait is extended by the hold.
